agreements: The current v2b bytes are not authorized for implementation, provider execution, GPU execution, review promotion, or ratification; a new v2c-equivalent package is required.

The admissible question remains a narrow postcommit, target-blind, no-feedback, query-guided public-evidence-allocation observation, not discovery, final behavior, LoRA, efficiency, memory superiority, population inference, or an automatic follow-up authority.

All cognition-time proposals must remain append-only and target/truth/scorer-blind; scoring must occur only after an independently verified immutable raw seal and must have no provider or control-flow edge.

Every future result, null, primary-undefined life, control win, integrity failure, timeout, and review outcome must stop at Rohin without repair, rerun, replication, claim promotion, external action, or spend authority.

disagreements.issue: V2b calls post-prefix inputs pre-provider and simultaneously requires unconditional branch cardinalities despite no-frontier and short-universe states.

positions.position: Precommit matching and fixed 802/288/18 totals apply to every life.
Matching depends on prefix/THINK results, so legitimate terminal states require manifest-derived cardinalities.

resolution.rationale: The proposed ordering is impossible for inputs that do not exist until after shared calls, and padding would fabricate scientific opportunities.
resolution.selected_position: Static validation first; post-prefix/pre-branch validation and terminal-manifest accounting second.
resolution.required_change: V2c correction 01: define temporal phases: (A0) static immutable input, environment, schedule-template, and scope validation before any provider call; (A1) shared prefix and bounded THINK_0 with unique sunk receipts; (A2) post-prefix/pre-branch target-blind universe, measured-balance, assignment, and branch-manifest gate; (B) only manifest-authorized branch calls; (C) raw seal; (D) scoring/final seal. Define DEFER, malformed/failed THINK_0, no valid frontier, and fewer-than-sixteen distinct candidates as explicit PRIMARY_UNDEFINED terminal manifests (recommended) with sunk A1 reporting, no resampling, duplication, padding, or fabricated views. Derive per-life and aggregate recurrent calls, selector traces, MEMORY_1 commits, scorer packets, exploratory calls, and terminal justification from the frozen terminal manifests; an alternative content-free missing-view branch protocol is allowed only if separately specified and tested.

disagreements.issue: No-feedback selection, distractor assignment, outcome target, and opportunity scope are not algorithmically bound.

positions.position: Named no-feedback and matched-distractor arms plus formulas are sufficient.
Selection and scoring must be deterministic and every arm must share one own outcome target.

resolution.rationale: A formula that classifies a selected pair does not select it, and arm-varying targets destroy the paired contrast.
resolution.selected_position: Freeze complete target-blind arm assignment before branch outcomes and score every arm against the same own q.
resolution.required_change: V2c correction 02: freeze a target-blind no-feedback candidate universe, rank, tie key, exclusions, and sixteen-slot mapping; freeze a recipient-local same-kind distractor universe, exclusions, one-to-one assignment/bijection policy, lexicographic matching objective, and semantic-hash final tie key. Define all no-match cases in the terminal manifest. Bind own q into every arm scorer packet; a distractor q may affect only trusted selection. Define one mechanical-closure-opportunity predicate (per candidate or union of the sixteen selected views), then use exactly that predicate for ranks, strata, controls, and scores.

disagreements.issue: Physical-slot seeds and unspecified branch order confound the allocation manipulation with decoding randomness and execution state.

positions.position: Physical call-slot seeding and receipt accounting are adequate.
Corresponding arm slots require common logical randomness independent of unique physical receipts.

resolution.rationale: At nonzero temperature, distinct physical slots create distinct random streams and make allocation not the sole intervention.
resolution.selected_position: Use common random numbers keyed by logical correspondence, while retaining physical identities solely for accounting.
resolution.required_change: V2c correction 03: derive an arm-independent logical seed from frozen run_id, life_id, stage, logical_round, and corresponding_slot; use it for each matched RETURN_SLEEP arm call. Keep physical slot/session/request/receipt IDs unique and exclude them from seed derivation. Precommit deterministic arm interleaving or execution order, enforce reset isolation, and prove provider request/config/parser bytes and decoded output invariance under permitted branch-order permutations except for the rendered selected public content.

disagreements.issue: EXACT/NEAR metric equality is described as exchangeability and supports causal wording that the current design cannot justify.

positions.position: Frozen low-dimensional equality/stratification establishes exchangeability.
It is only measured balance and leaves semantic and visible-interface confounding.

resolution.rationale: Matching observed fields is not randomization or probabilistic exchangeability, particularly for three selected pairs.
resolution.selected_position: Measured-balance diagnostics with qualified within-life language only after the seed and same-target repairs.
resolution.required_change: V2c correction 04: rename EXACT and NEAR to measured-balance strata; publish all allowed visible imbalances and shortcut survivors; forbid population inference and any statement that matching removes confounding. Before corrections 02 and 03, describe results only as associated differences. Afterwards, permit 'changed' only for the precisely defined within-life allocation intervention with common logical seeds and the same own q; retain all non-discovery and non-superiority claim prohibitions.

disagreements.issue: The proposed complete graph circularly requires score/control artifacts before code may score them.

positions.position: One complete verifier runs before scorer import.
A raw-only seal must unlock scoring, followed by a distinct final closure verifier.

resolution.rationale: A verifier cannot require artifacts that do not yet exist without either failing every run or silently weakening the barrier.
resolution.selected_position: Separate raw and final immutable evidence phases.
resolution.required_change: V2c correction 05: phase A creates an immutable raw inventory of manifests, provider receipts, parser/proposal rows, selector traces, checkpoints, aliases, terminal rows, and required raw controls; an independent raw verifier emits a raw-seal hash. All runner subprocesses must import-block scorer/target/oracle/allowlist modules until that seal. Phase B is a no-provider scorer/control process producing score packets, metrics, summaries, and a final inventory; an independent final verifier checks both phase-A references and phase-B completeness. done.json is permitted only after the phase-B final seal. Reject premature imports, phase-A omissions, post-score omissions, and mutation of either seal.

disagreements.issue: Subtracting a maximum of heterogeneous once-per-life controls from sixteen evolving model slots is not a model residual or compiler-adjusted estimand.

positions.position: Signed model-minus-maximum-control residuals quantify model contribution.
Controls are diagnostic unless exactly common-unit and schema-legal.

resolution.rationale: Privileged oracle/query-copy inputs and unequal opportunity counts preclude residual causal attribution.
resolution.selected_position: Separately labeled diagnostics plus common-unit comparable controls only.
resolution.required_change: V2c correction 06: retain every deterministic control as a labeled sufficiency/opportunity diagnostic, not a residual. Report common-unit any closure, unique semantic closure, first post-branch closure, duplicate count, and closure per legal proposal opportunity. Where a compiler control is model-comparable, execute it per selected slot with the same schema-legal visible input and opportunity denominator. Never pool, clip, or label privileged query-copy/public-witness-oracle differences as latent reasoning, model contribution, or residual.

disagreements.issue: Configuration hashes and device capacity do not demonstrate that the exact resident engine can execute maximum envelopes with reset isolation.

positions.position: The H100 threshold and declared configuration establish feasibility.
Observed zero-science-call allocation and reset receipts are required.

resolution.rationale: Actual allocator headroom, cache disablement, and session reset are runtime facts, not source-file facts.
resolution.selected_position: Lock-bound live preflight with no scientific calls before any branch launch.
resolution.required_change: V2c correction 07: run a zero-science-call preflight on the exact locked bf16 revision and device before science. Exercise every maximum declared input/output call class, record model/provider revision, peak allocation, cache-disablement, empty KV/session/request reset, logical seed, unique physical receipt, token counts, and receipt telemetry. Fail closed before science on any mismatch, capacity shortfall, cache/session reuse, reset failure, or missing telemetry; preserve logical seeds separately from physical receipts.

disagreements.issue: Raw connector redaction does not eliminate allowed visible structures such as shared-C equality, alias multiplicity, ordering, lexical texture, or renderer templates.

positions.position: Alias redaction and hidden-field byte separation make the provider target-blind.
Forbidden identity leakage and permitted treatment-mediated visible shortcuts require different dispositions.

resolution.rationale: A visible shortcut can qualify interpretation even when it is not forbidden private/final leakage.
resolution.selected_position: One-to-one redaction plus complete visible-survivor audit and claim qualification.
resolution.required_change: V2c correction 08: preserve one-to-one external C-alias ledgers and reject raw/private/final identity leakage. Expand the 1000-pair audit/report/stratification to shared-C equality, alias multiplicity, slot/order, endpoint frequency, lexical texture, schema position, renderer templates, repaired selection bytes, complete request bytes, and decoding-config bytes. Fail on forbidden leakage; report allowed survivors as treatment-mediated shortcuts that qualify claims rather than treating them as invisible or proof of blindness.

disagreements.issue: Mutable intake transition state has been placed in interpretation/review context, creating self-reference and invalidating otherwise valid control-plane transitions.

positions.position: Intake state can be hash-bound with architecture evidence.
Mutable intake is command state, not immutable interpretation context.

resolution.rationale: Interpretation and review evidence must stay immutable while intake history necessarily records later transitions.
resolution.selected_position: Prohibit mutable intake state from architecture interpretation and review context.
resolution.required_change: V2c correction 09: prohibit every mutable intake-state path or hash, including intake.restarted.state.json, from interpretation context_files, critique/consensus review evidence, transitive review closures, and artifact evidence. State hashes may appear only in intake transition records for transition verification. Bind review to immutable proposal/spec/scope/workflow/interpretation/test/resource bytes and, if needed, a separately named immutable state snapshot with explicit creation time and hash. Add a validator that rejects mutable intake context and requires identical immutable reviewer inputs.

disagreements.issue: The current unratified scope cannot authorize implementation or a costly ambiguous run.

positions.position: The v2b package can proceed once its named checks are available.
All repaired bytes require fresh deliberation, exact ratification, preflight, and identical independent review.

resolution.rationale: Neither agreement among artifacts nor this consensus grants human authority, and unresolved blocking defects make the present run non-informative.
resolution.selected_position: New v2c package and full governance path before any implementation or execution authority.
resolution.required_change: V2c correction 10: create a new exact package containing corrections 01-09 and replacement fixtures; obtain two fresh independent interpretations, cross-critique, a consensus disposing every concern/disagreement/test, and exact human ratification of only the repaired scope. Then permit only scoped implementation, CPU checks, the live zero-science preflight, and identical independent review of the immutable closure before any provider call, sync, or GPU launch. No artifact may infer implementation permission from this rework consensus.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Blocking undefined treatment and outcome mapping.
Blocking claim overreach from measured matching.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Apply correction 04 in the v2c spec and claims.
Apply correction 07 before any science call.
Apply correction 08 before interpreting model rows.
Apply correction 09 before any fresh interpretation.

concern_dispositions.rationale: No human authority is present and all repairs require a new package.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: Named arms need deterministic selection and assignment bytes.
A raw seal must precede and differ from final scored closure.
Only observed exact-engine telemetry establishes the required runtime boundary.
Post-prefix inputs cannot support a literal before-all-calls claim.
Legitimate no-frontier and short-universe branches require terminal manifests.
Paired outcomes require same own q and a frozen distractor algorithm.
Measured field balance is not exchangeability.
Heterogeneous privileged controls cannot yield a residual model contribution.
Causal wording is conditional on same target and common randomness repairs.
The current package does not justify the proposed spend.

acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Retain exclusions and make v2c implementation prohibition explicit until exact ratification.
Add observed maximum-envelope allocation and reset telemetry.
Split static and post-prefix gates and cover primary-undefined states.
Use canonical measured-balance metrics, assignment, and opportunity scope.
Bind zero eligibility to terminal manifests and measured-balance reporting.
Audit redaction separately from allowed visible shortcut survivors.
Add same target, logical seeds, branch-order, and repaired selection-byte checks.
Exercise maximum live preflight envelopes as well as canonical legality.
Cover phase-A scorer import prohibition and no feedback through raw seal.
Replace unconditional totals with terminal-manifest-derived cardinalities and sunk receipts.
Separate logical seed correspondence from unique physical receipt identities.
Require independent phase-A raw seal before any scorer import in every subprocess.
Bind all score packets to same own q and common-unit outcome rows.
Forbid heterogeneous residuals and require per-slot comparable controls where feasible.
Report all allowed survivors and distinguish them from forbidden leakage.
Retain heterogeneous labels and prohibit residual/superiority language.
Require independently verified phase-A raw and phase-B final graphs.
Reject mutable intake state from interpretation/review context and bind immutable snapshots only.
Require identical immutable reviewer closures without mutable intake evidence.
Reconcile terminal manifests and keep mutable state only in transition control records.
Require a fresh v2c ratification and forbid auto-go from this consensus.

questions: Does Rohin require a newly hash-bound v2c-equivalent package implementing corrections 01-10 before considering ratification of any analysis or GPU scope?

For no-frontier and short-universe lives, does Rohin select the recommended PRIMARY_UNDEFINED terminal-manifest policy with sunk-call reporting, rather than a separately specified content-free branch protocol?

After the repaired package, fresh deliberation, exact ratification, CPU checks, live zero-science preflight, and identical independent review, does Rohin authorize considering one bounded calibration run with no implied repair, rerun, replication, or broader claim?
